svg.aria-label: The GitHub contribution calendar of the last 52 weeks drawn as an isometric plate of cells, one per day: a flat cell when there was no contribution, otherwise a block on four height levels, the two tallest in green, and a red pin on today. 9,744 contributions on 292 days in 52 weeks, best day Nov 1 with 1,564. In 2026: 9,528 contributions, 209 commits, 74 pull requests, 2 issues, 0 reviews. 74 public repositories, 16 stars, 15 followers.
